units.description: Read AGENTS.md first. The LLDs own every name. Write a test for each acceptance criterion this unit owns: PLAT-1, PLAT-2, PLAT-3, PLAT-5, PLAT-4 (their text is in docs/prd/components/PRD-platform-v3.md section 2.4); start each test's docstring with `@spec <ID>:` and put a `# @spec <ID>` comment on the behavior's entry point in code. ECC merges main into your branch before each attempt; if it did, keep both sides and make your unit pass on top. If a file your unit needs belongs to a dependency that is not merged yet, do not create it: finish what you can and report status blocked naming the missing unit; ECC re-runs you after it merges. Do not add __init__.py files under tests/ and do not edit pyproject.toml, uv.lock or any package __init__.py (M0-01 owns them). Never touch the v1 repository (my-research-mcp-server) or ~/arxiv-papers, never read real credentials or the Keychain, and use fakes and recorded fixtures for every external system; tests pass with the network blocked. A prior attempt exists read-only at ~/Documents/GitHub/my-research-mcp; you may read it, but the LLDs win wherever they differ, and the plan's clarifications list defects that attempt shipped.
